build_detection_train_loader: build a dataloader for single-task object detection training with configurable mapper and sampler
build_detection_train_loader_multi_task: build a multi-task dataloader combining 2D and 3D datasets with separate batch sizes and grouped batch sampling
build_detection_test_loader: build a test dataloader for inference with inference sampler and trivial batch collation
merge_datasets: merge multiple datasets with optional balancing and multiplication using configurable mappers
get_detection_dataset_dicts: load and prepare dataset dicts from the DatasetCatalog with optional proposal files and subsampling
